input.summary: Lumen Peptide Trading (V04), contact Jasper. Trader, not manufacturer: products made by partner plants in China and Korea. Claims OTIF 97%, rejection 0.5%, but no records to share yet (new in India); offered 2 Singapore references. Says suitable for cosmetics, ISO 9001 at manufacturer level, SDS to follow. Density of both solutions about 1.03. Sent a rate card photo and COA for Copper Tripeptide-1. Open: RM-008 strength quoted on carnosic acid, spec is rosmarinic acid 20%; RM-009 COA shows 812 ppm vs 1000 ppm quoted. Outstanding knockouts: Q5 (COA per line), Q9 (SDS, leave-on suitability). Others: Q6, Q8. Reply due 14 Nov 2026.

input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: clarifications needed on RM-008, RM-009 and questionnaire items
input.body:
Dear Jasper,

Thank you for your quote, the rate card and the COA for Copper Tripeptide-1.

Please answer the following so we can complete our review:

RM-008 Rosemary leaf extract
1. Your strength is stated as carnosic acid. Our spec is 20% rosmarinic acid. Please confirm the rosmarinic acid content of the batch you would supply, with a COA showing that marker.

RM-009 Copper Tripeptide-1 solution
2. The COA you sent shows 812 ppm, while the quote states 1,000 ppm. Please confirm which strength you will supply. Our spec is 1,000 ppm peptide. If the batch you would supply is below this, please say so and send the COA for that batch.

Mandatory documents
3. A Certificate of Analysis for each line (RM-001 to RM-010) from a recent batch, showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date.
4. The Safety Data Sheet for each line, and confirmation that each material is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020.
5. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, and the certifications you hold (for example ISO 9001) with their expiry dates. Please state which of these apply to the manufacturing site, not only to your company.
6. Are you the manufacturer or a trader? Please name the manufacturer and site for each line, any second source, and whether you will share delivery and rejection records for the last 12 months. We would also welcome the two Singapore references you mentioned.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Regards,
Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
